headlines.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia lands in Spain a ‘free man’ after deportation battle
headlines.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has landed in Spain after leaving the United States at the end of a closely watched and controversial deportation battle that became a symbol for the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.

headlines.title: Fort Hood mass shooter makes legal move to stop Pentagon’s firing squad execution
headlines.description: The former Army officer whose scheduled military execution by firing squad provoked outrage over an initial proposal to livestream his death is planning to file a constitutional challenge that could halt his December execution, his lawyers said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Sources: Trump administration considers targeting Iranian regime hardliners
headlines.description: A U.S. official and a person with knowledge tell NBC News the Trump administration is considering targeting Iranian regime hardliners who are seen as an obstacle to reaching a deal that would end the war. NBC News’ Courtney Kube reports.

headlines.title: Tech stocks take a dip as Jensen Huang comes back as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Tech stocks dipped after Jensen Huang was reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia. Huang reportedly apologized for his extramarital relationships and said that he is now in daily therapy.

headlines.title: Sen. Gillibrand says 60-seat Senate majority ‘on the table’ in 2028
headlines.description: NBC News’ Sahil Kapur goes one-on-one with DSCC Chair Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D-N.Y.) on Democrats’ path to expanding their Senate majority in 2028 and whether a filibuster-proof majority is within reach.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Trump says pardon is always an option for Huang, and that invoking the Fifth isn’t necessary
headlines.description: The president’s assertion that Huang does not pose a national security threat has sparked bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill, where the Nvidia CEO is set to testify next week.

headlines.title: Judge orders Georgia’s Fulton County to turn over copies of 2020 ballots to Trump-allied election board
headlines.description: The State Election Board, which sets and enforces Georgia’s election rules, is under the control of activists aligned with Trump and his false claims of a stolen election.

headlines.title: Authorities drop criminal charge against incoming House Democrat over unreturned rental car
headlines.description: The summons for Rep.-elect LaKesha Womack was issued in 2020, but law enforcement didn’t serve the warrant until last month, at a campaign event, court records show.

headlines.title: How Democrats are gaming out the timing of their 2028 bids: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Natasha Korecki explores when we might see Democratic presidential contenders launch their campaigns.

headlines.title: Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom, the nation’s highest civilian honor
headlines.description: Giuliani was hailed for his actions as New York City’s mayor during the 9/11 attacks, but was later disbarred for pushing President Donald Trump’s false election fraud claims.

headlines.title: Blanche calls Nvidia a ‘good corporate citizen’ while dodging questions on probe
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche praised Nvidia as a “good corporate citizen” while sidestepping questions about the Justice Department’s role in the president’s controversial decision to push for the reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang.
